verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that requests need "an API key from your incident.io dashboard". Nothing documents scoping those keys, limiting their permissions, or issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Audit logs of permission changes and the Investigations trust-and-safety page ("stay within the bounds you set") are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
